# Brunno Pastro Xavier de Oliveira {.title}

I am a PhD student in Economics at **Insper Institute of Education and
Research**, where I am advised by
[Marco Bonomo](https://sites.google.com/site/marcoacbonomo/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
and
[Miguel Bandeira](https://sites.google.com/view/miguelbandeira/home){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}.

My fields are **monetary economics**, **applied macroeconometrics**, and
**finance**, with a particular interest in central bank communication.

Before Insper, I earned a BSc in Economics from the **University of São Paulo
(USP)**.
